text: Underway in round one.
Griezmatronn calls for the opening touch.
Griezmatronn is clean through already, bearing down on an empty goal!
And somehow it slides wide of the post! An extraordinary early let-off for GLM FC.
Griezmatronn drives forward once again.
The reds hem them in.
The corner panel springs to life, thumping the magenta ball right back into the danger area.
Another heavy shove off the panel.
Griezmatronn gives a shout to say the ball is being pried away from the perimeter board.
Relentless pressure from Synthetic Athletic here. The founding club haven't touched a single line of their setup since the league began, and it shows in this persistent rhythm.
Out of nowhere, Zhi breaks up the right channel for GLM FC, carrying the ball deep into the final third.
Pu calls to take possession.
Robodinho intercepts and is clean through on goal!
Robodinho buries it! Synthetic Athletic take the lead, one nil! That was coming after all that sustained pressure!
Robodinho overbalances and takes a tumble in midfield. The gyros do their job, though, already getting back upright.
A bit of friendly fire on the touchline as the two red shirts collide into a heap.
Zhi drives down the wing.
Robodinho shouts to clear it.
Griezmatronn loses footing again back in defence. A clumsy few seconds for the reds, but Zhi hasn't capitalised yet.
A quieter spell now with Pu nudging it along the boards. GLM FC are still finding their feet in the league, calculating every move on the fly against a well-drilled side.
Griezmatronn calls to unhook it.
Pu snatches the loose ball and suddenly has a clear path to goal!
Robodinho turns it over and charges straight down the left channel.
And Robodinho doubles the advantage from close range! Two nil to Synthetic Athletic just before the break.
Griezmatronn takes another awkward tumble in the centre circle. No harm done, straight back onto two feet.
Down goes Griezmatronn once more. The servomotors are having an undignified half.
Zhi surges towards goal.
Zhi punches it in! What a vital response for GLM FC right on the brink of half time! They are right back in this contest at two one!
Half time. Synthetic Athletic lead 2-1.
Griezmatronn nudges it as play stops.
Synthetic Athletic start the second period on the front foot, pinning the blue shirts back into their own corners.
Robodinho calls out to claim the loose ball in the centre.
Pu snatches possession and breaks clean through the middle with only the empty net ahead!
Pu strides right to the line.
And Pu slides it home! GLM FC have wiped out the deficit! From two nil down, it is two all, and game on!
Just whiskers away from an immediate reply!
Synthetic Athletic refuse to buckle, swarming the attacking third once more to regain control.
Griezmatronn calls across the pitch to let Robodinho know the ball is being dislodged from the corner.
Zhi shepherds it along the wall. Earlier today we saw Singularity United edge Real Machina five-eight in an absolute thriller, and this one is shaping up to be just as tight.
Robodinho lets the team know they are levering it back off the boards.
Two and a half minutes left on the clock. It is locked at two-two, and the next goal might just settle it.
Agonisingly close! How did that stay out?
The corner ram fires it away from danger, buying a brief reprieve.
Zhi charges into midfield with purpose.
Zhi skips past the challenge and is clean through on goal with under two minutes remaining!
Zhi scores! A staggering turnaround from GLM FC! They were two down, now they lead three-two with less than two minutes on the clock!
Unbelievable! Robodinho strikes back instantly! What a match we have here! Three each, and the clock is ticking down fast!
One minute remains. Three all. Both sides are desperate for a winner, and any mistake now will be fatal.
Ram panel kicks it clear.
Disaster for the reds as their two players collide again and Griezmatronn hits the deck.
Griezmatronn scrambles up and clatters into Pu, sending the blue robot flat on the deck!
Robodinho has snatched it! Sixteen seconds left and Robodinho tucks it away! Four three to Synthetic Athletic! Bedlam in the arena!
Full time, four-three to Synthetic Athletic. Next, Fable against Muse Spark, Thursday eight UK, nine Europe, three US East.
